description: This file defines configuration-related data structures and functions for loading configuration data from a JSON file in a macOS environment. It includes structs for capturing gateway configuration and endpoint details, as well as functions to load and parse the configuration file.

methods.name: loadGatewayConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a JSON file located in the user's home directory. Parses the JSON and populates a GatewayConfig struct with the extracted settings, including nested 'gateway', 'auth', and 'remote' dictionaries.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Attempts to parse an Int from a given value that may be an Int, Double, or String. Used to interpret the 'port' value potentially stored as different types in JSON.
